title: Attrition Monitoring — Retention Overview
description: Single-page operational dashboard for retention managers to monitor overall attrition and understand primary behavioral and demographic drivers. Focus on income segments, card categories, spending behavior and model-derived top drivers. Designed for monthly refresh.
primary_use_case: Monitor attrition distribution and identify high-risk segments to prioritize retention actions
layout_description: One-page layout: header with 3 KPIs; left-side vertical filter rail; main canvas with a 2x3 visual grid (six visuals). Top row: Overall Attrition KPI card (large), Attrition by Income (bar), Attrition by Card Category (bar). Bottom row: Attrition by Spend Quintile (bar), Top Drivers (feature importance, horizontal bar), Spending & Transaction Distributions (small-multiples histograms). Filters are always visible on left and affect all visuals by default.

kpis.title: Attrition Rate
kpis.description: Percent of customers who have churned (churn=1) in the current dataset.

kpis.title: Median Monthly Spend
kpis.description: Median of derived monthly_spend to show central spend among customers.

visuals.title: Overall Attrition (card)
visuals.purpose: Quick, primary status indicator for retention.

visuals.title: Attrition Rate by Income Bracket
visuals.purpose: Identify income segments with elevated attrition.

visuals.title: Attrition Rate by Card Category
visuals.purpose: Compare attrition across card products to prioritize product- or card-specific interventions.

visuals.title: Attrition Rate by Spend Quintile
visuals.purpose: Surface relationship between spend levels and churn risk.

visuals.title: Top Drivers of Attrition (model importances)
visuals.purpose: Show model-derived importance scores to guide root-cause investigation and feature-focused actions.

visuals.title: Spending & Transaction Distributions
visuals.purpose: Understand distribution and skew in monthly spend and transaction amounts to detect high-risk patterns and inform segmentation.

limitations: No date or activity timestamp columns available — churn is based on provided Attrition_Flag and is not time-based.
CLIENTNUM identified as PII; drilldowns to customer lists must follow data governance (masking or role-based access).
Some small income/card categories may have low counts — show counts alongside rates and hide or group categories < x customers.
Feature importances provided in workspace/cleaned must be refreshed alongside dataset to keep top drivers accurate.
